notes:
Beta — safer handling when your backup drive changes.

- If your backup drive fills up or goes missing, you can move the wedding to another drive or copy the cards onto a new one, and SafeStore keeps track of which drive holds what
- Empty transfers no longer get stuck on a full or missing drive, and adding a second SD card while uploads run no longer leaves stray files in Dropbox
- Clearer messages when a drive, card or Dropbox step needs you
- No change to how footage is copied or verified
- This is a test build. To go back, use Back to stable in Settings: you keep this build until the next regular update
